page_title: CAG 2-0 PAR | Cagliari v Parma 13/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Mandela Keita (Parma) sends a long ball in, but Elia Caprile comfortably gathers the ball.
90+7' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+5' The game is interrupted now, Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+3' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+3' Mandela Keita (Parma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
90+2' Milan Djuric (Parma) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francesco Fourneau signals.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
87' A substitution has been made. Michael Folorunsho goes off and Jose Pedro (Cagliari) comes on.
85' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Oliver Sorensen is replaced by Mandela Keita (Parma).
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Patrick Cutrone will be replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
84' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Francesco Fourneau due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) and his team.
81' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
80' Carlos Cuesta is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) suffers an injury and Nahuel Estevez comes on.
79' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' 2 - 0 Goal! Mattia Felici (Cagliari) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
77' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
75' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
74' Here is a change. Sebastiano Esposito is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Mattia Felici (Cagliari).
74' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Andrea Belotti leaves the pitch to be replaced by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari).
71' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
69' Elia Caprile pulls off a great save to deny Patrick Cutrone (Parma), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.

67' Fine attempt! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
65' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
62' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pontus Almqvist (Parma) replacing Mathias Lovik.
62' Francesco Fourneau shows the yellow card to Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) for a heavy challenge.
59' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francesco Fourneau ignores the protests.

57' A cross from the by-line finds Patrick Cutrone (Parma) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
56' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Zion Suzuki makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
55' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Gabriele Zappa and he is replaced by Marco Palestra (Cagliari).
54' The referee signals a substitution. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Gianluca Gaetano.
54' Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight and sees a foul from Yerry Mina (Cagliari).

53' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
52' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

51' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile keeps it out. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.
50' The referee blows his whistle as Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.
48' Adam Obert (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francesco Fourneau no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Christian Ordonez will be replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+2' Christian Ordonez (Parma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45+2' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
44' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
43' An attempted cross from Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is cleared.
42' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
41' Rough tackle by Mathias Lovik (Parma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
36' Mathias Lovik (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
33' 1 - 0 Yerry Mina (Cagliari) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the roof of the net, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
33' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
33' Cagliari get a corner.
33' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Cagliari get a corner.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) heads on.
30' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Elia Caprile is alert and denies him.
29' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Christian Ordonez (Parma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
27' The referee blows for a cooling break.
26' A raking crossfield pass from Enrico Del Prato (Parma) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
25' The free kick is delivered by Emanuele Valeri (Parma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
23' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
23' Alessandro Circati (Parma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Fourneau saw the whole situation.
22' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is behind the touchline and Parma will take a throw-in.
21' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

20' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
18' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
15' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
14' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
13' Adam Obert (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
11' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
8' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
8' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Elia Caprile. What a save!
7' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Elia Caprile stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
4' Now Parma have a corner.
2' Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau is introduced as the referee for today's match.
